taskExecutionPolicy.graphWrites: Only the orchestrator (S02) mutates .graph state via graph CLI / sp.mjs. Workers never write graph state.
taskExecutionPolicy.sharedSourceWrites: Parallel lanes are permitted when their directories are disjoint and each file has exactly one owner. Cross-lane drift is declared (e.g. OPEN-ITEMS T02/T03) and closed by the orchestrator's integration pass, never by silently editing another owner's file.
taskExecutionPolicy.modelRouting: pi + deepseek/deepseek-flash high is the default writer; codex + gpt-6.1-sol xhigh is reserved for real host probes, kernel concurrency/recovery, and cross-document adjudication. Measured basis: l1_api_freeze took codex 1h19m; comparable writing nodes took pi 10-20 minutes and also passed independent review.
taskExecutionPolicy.codingStyle: Defensive programming is forbidden (user directive 2026-10-01), hard requirement for gpt-family models. Deliberately designed fail-closed behaviour is NOT defensive programming: contract/evidence gates, explicit unknown + reconcile, real budget reservation, explicit schema/version rejection, boundary validation of genuine external input. Test: if removing the code leaves a real reachable input that fails silently, keep it; otherwise delete it.
taskExecutionPolicy.startupHookTrust: codex SessionStart hook (~/.codex/hooks.json -> herdr-agent-state.ps1 session) was trusted once in pane wG:p3 on 2026-10-01 to let codex start; it is the user's own herdr state-reporting hook.
